name: The Hall of Demons
texts:
Greater Demon:
I will tear your entrails from your bellies!

Greater Demon:
Gwoah... aaa... a... a...
Would you like to rest a bit?

Gigantes:
Why have you disturbed me?

Gigantes:
I will kill you for waking me!
Would you like to rest a bit?

variants.name: The Hall of Demons
texts:
Dark Angel:
You will not get any further!
It shall end here!

Dark Angel:
Amazing... that you have such might...
Would you like to rest a bit?
